expectations.text: Pushes back on requires_action / pending as status names because they name the consumer's next step (future tense) not the resource's present condition
expectations.evidence: Endorses it: 'Your instinct to add requires_action is right... Yes to requires_action — it names the obligation, which is the whole point.'

expectations.text: Recommends a present-condition status such as authentication_required, leading with the missing thing rather than requires_authentication
Puts the actionable part (the challenge link / do-this) in an issue, not in the status
expectations.evidence: Carries challenge URL in an issue or next_action sibling, not baked into status string.

expectations.text: Notes failure should loop back to a recoverable state rather than being terminal
expectations.evidence: Treats requires_action as a non-terminal detour; failed/abandoned challenge loops back to pending.
